subject: Daz
fact: Daz has chosen Fey Touched as his feat, granting him two additional prepared spells and free castings, and has integrated Misty Step and Sculpt Spells into a synergistic system for battlefield control, prioritizing spell selection and spatial geometry over raw damage.
source_quote: Fey Touched was the one. I wrote it down with the quiet satisfaction of a calculation that checks out.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir has committed to a tactical specialization centered on grappling and binding, using a grapple to lock enemies in place for Daz’s Cloud of Daggers, then employing rope to bind them — creating a two-turn setup that maximizes control and action economy in confined spaces.
source_quote: The grapple could happen in the spare moment before my main action. The binding would consume the action itself.

subject: The Narrator
fact: The Narrator has undergone a dark transition in identity, moving from a cautious, potion-hoarding dwarf raised by giants to someone who now embraces brutal, specialized builds — rejecting spread-thin survivability in favor of high-impact, one-directional power, acknowledging the influence of Zhentarim Tactics and the Underdark’s moral erosion.
source_quote: I understood that better now than I would have liked.

subject: Zhentarim
fact: The Zhentarim are recognized as a ruthless, effective organization that survives by doing what others won't — their tactics are now being considered as a legitimate, if uncomfortable, framework for the Narrator’s evolving combat philosophy.
source_quote: The Zhentarim have survived by being willing to do what others won't.

subject: level-up threshold
fact: The party has collectively reached a level-up milestone, triggering deep reflection on character builds, feat selection, and tactical specialization — marking a narrative inflection point where survival now demands decisive commitment over caution.

subject: Ebonmire’s spellbook
fact: The spellbook taken from Princess Ebonmire remains an unopened resource, but its potential to expand prepared spells is now central to Daz’s feat strategy — a latent power that could redefine his role in future encounters.
source_quote: The door I hadn't fully opened.

subject: The Underdark
fact: The Underdark is portrayed as a biomechanical prison of tight tunnels and lethal geometry, where battles are decided by positioning, not power — forcing the party to adapt their tactics to a world that punishes spread-thin builds and rewards specialized, synergistic combat systems.
source_quote: The Underdark has taught me repeatedly that battles are often decided by who is standing where.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a radiant weapon that does not cut but burns — a divine tool that argues with darkness on a philosophical level, making it potent against undead and shadow creatures but vulnerable to creatures with resistance to radiant damage.
source_quote: The blade doesn't cut so much as it burns — clean, divine, the kind of light that argues with darkness on a philosophical level.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King was previously defeated through Zalthir’s extreme tactical geometry — a feat that demonstrated the effectiveness of hyper-specialized builds over conventional approaches, and now serves as a benchmark for the party’s evolving combat philosophy.
source_quote: I'd watched him pull the Pudding King out of its lair by sheer force of tactical geometry.

subject: session time
fact: The party's feat and ability selection process will take the rest of the day — a deliberate, narrative pause marking the transition from reactive survival to intentional, strategic character evolution.
source_quote: That's gonna take the rest of the day.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir has killed an ettin with his hands and dragged the Pudding King through his own throne room, and now focuses on tying knots for Daz while accepting the practical realities of their mission.
source_quote: I have killed an ettin with my hands. I dragged the Pudding King through his own throne room.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin has acquired facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct — and advocates for javelins to hold the gap in the next engagement, finding humor in the name 'Ember Grapple'.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He had apparently acquired some facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in, applied to range.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum made a sound and may have found the name 'Ember Grapple' funny, alongside Thorin, though it is unclear who exactly reacted.
source_quote: Grygum made a sound. Thorin said something about 'the Ember Grapple.' Someone — possibly Thorin again, possibly Grygum, it is hard to tell when they are both making noise — found this very funny.

subject: Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash, announcing itself — possibly the same entity as the Ember Grapple, described from a different perspective.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash and the announcement of itself.

subject: Ember Grapple
fact: The Ember Grapple holds something still until there is nothing left to hold — possibly the same entity as the Ember Vanguard, described from a different position in the room.
source_quote: The Ember Grapple holds something still until there is nothing left to hold.

subject: javelins
fact: Javelins have been acquired by Thorin and are intended for use in the next engagement to hold the gap, valued for their reach and practicality.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He wanted something with reach for the next engagement.

subject: tunnels
fact: Zalthir has mentally retraced the tunnels they traveled, noting the distance, pace, and absence of immediate threats ahead.
source_quote: I turned that over the way I turn most things over: once, completely, and then I put it down. The math was the math. What we had was what we had.

subject: no long rest
fact: No long rest will occur before the next engagement, as resources are not replenished by wish or expectation.
source_quote: There would be no long rest before whatever came next. Nothing replenished itself on account of wishing.

subject: Ember Grapple identity
fact: The identity of the Ember Grapple versus the Ember Vanguard remains ambiguous — possibly two descriptions of the same faction from differing perspectives.
source_quote: Both accurate. Possibly the same party described from two different positions in the room.
